svg:
Doppler: moving observer – relative speed changes, wavelength in medium unchanged
source fixed <circle cx="200" cy="150" r="30" fill="none" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:0.8"/> <circle cx="200" cy="150" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:0.8"/> <circle cx="200" cy="150" r="90" fill="none" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:0.8"/>
observer v_o → source <line x1="350" y1="150" x2="320" y2="150" stroke="#0b7a4b" stroke-width:1.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
f' = f * (v + v_o)/v (approaching) f' = f * (v - v_o)/v (receding) λ unchanged in medium, but observer meets wavefronts faster/slower Distinction: moving source → λ' changes; moving observer → v_rel changes. Valid: v_o < v, non-relativistic, medium at rest
